title: Manager, General Accounting
jobDescription:
Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data. Organizations around the world rely on Alation to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed. Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together. Alation is seeking a motivated and driven International Accounting Manager to join our Corporate Accounting team, based out of our Chennai, India office. Reporting to the Assistant Controller, this role is a critical member of our global finance organization, owning the accounting and compliance functions for Alation's international subsidiaries across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM. As Alation continues to scale, this individual will play a key role in ensuring financial integrity, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance across our global footprint. This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role that requires flexibility and availability to engage with global stakeholders across multiple time zones, including overlap with US business hours. What you'll be doing: Own the end-to-end accounting operations for all non-US subsidiaries, including EMEA, APAC, and LATAM entities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP and applicable local standards. Manage statutory compliance and local filing requirements across all international jurisdictions, partnering with local advisors and external auditors as needed. Lead the month-end and quarter-end close processes for international entities, including intercompany transactions, eliminations, and reconciliations. Partner with the Corporate Accounting team in the US to support consolidated financial reporting and ensure alignment across the global close process. Serve as the primary point of contact for international audit activities, coordinating documentation, responses, and deliverables across all jurisdictions. Lead, mentor, and develop two Senior Accountants, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Identify and implement process improvements to drive efficiency, scalability, and controls across the international accounting function. Support transfer pricing documentation and intercompany agreements in collaboration with legal and tax teams. Assist with technical accounting research and memos as they relate to international operations. You should have: 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with significant exposure to international and multi-entity accounting. CPA, CA, or equivalent professional certification strongly preferred. Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and experience with local statutory reporting requirements across multiple international jurisdictions. Experience working within a private Saa S or technology company is a plus. Hands-on experience with ERP systems; Net Suite experience strongly preferred. A self-starter mindset with a strong sense of ownership, someone who takes initiative, drives work forward independently, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. Proven ability to manage and develop a team, with a track record of building high-performing accounting functions. Flexibility and willingness to work across global time zones, including availability during US business hours as needed to support cross-functional collaboration. Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across geographies and time zones. High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and process excellence. Nice to have: Net Suite design and development experience How You Succeed: Raise the Bar: Deliver work with exceptional rigor, continuously elevate standards, and hold the team to a high level of quality and accuracy. Move with Urgency: Act decisively, prioritize effectively, and drive the close process and compliance deliverables forward without losing momentum. Win Through Results: Focus relentlessly on measurable outcomes; accurate financials, on-time filings, and a well-controlled international accounting function. Build Exceptional Teams: Strengthen cross-functional collaboration across geographies and foster shared accountability within your team of Senior Accountants. Act Like an Owner: Take responsibility for the health of the international accounting function, solve problems proactively, and think long term about scalability and process excellence. #LI-AS1 Alation, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. title: Senior Product Manager II
jobDescription:
About Alation Alation is the creator of AIOS — the intelligence operating system for enterprises that cannot afford to get AI wrong. When software breaks, it throws an error. When an AI agent breaks, it produces a confident, wrong answer — and most organizations have no system to catch it before that answer drives a decision. AIOS keeps data, context, and agents in sync in one open, governed, self-improving system, so every decision an agent makes holds up. Having pioneered the data catalog market, Alation is trusted by over 600 enterprises worldwide — including 40% of the Fortune 500 — to power their most critical data and AI initiatives. The problems we tackle are complex, high-impact, and deeply technical.This is not a slow-moving environment. We build fast, ship real things, learn from customers, and iterate relentlessly. About the Role AIOS doesn't work without connectivity. Agents fail when bad data reaches them, when context is stale, or when the environment shifts underneath them — and the defense against all three starts with rich, current metadata flowing in from the systems where enterprise data actually lives. Connectors are how AIOS sees the enterprise. That's this team's job, and it's getting harder and more interesting as the data and AI landscape shifts under everyone's feet. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own this problem end to end. You'll inherit a portfolio of 80+ integrations spanning the modern and legacy data stack, and a mandate to define what connectivity means in an agentic world — new systems, new types of sources (including the agents and AI tools that are themselves becoming metadata sources), new extraction techniques, and AI applied wherever it genuinely moves the needle. This is a senior IC role with real scope. You won't be handed a polished roadmap or mature systems — you'll sharpen the strategy, make the calls, and ship. This is a role for builders. What You'll Do Own the Connector mission: make it fast and easy for customers to bring rich, valuable metadata into AIOS Drive the strategy for 80+ existing integrations — what to deepen, what to optimize, what to sunset Lead expansion into new systems and entirely new categories of data sources as the AI landscape reshapes what "a data source" means Turn ambiguous problems into clear direction, scoped bets, and shipped solutions Talk to customers constantly — validate direction, pressure-test ideas, iterate fast Work directly with engineering to define requirements, reason through tradeoffs, and move quickly Apply AI strategically across the connector portfolio — both in the product and in how you work Raise the bar on how we build, not just what we build Who This Role Is For We care more about how you operate than where you've been. Traits and trajectory matter to us more than a checklist of domain credentials. You might be a great fit if you: Are gritty and resilient — you don't stall when things are unclear or hard Have a strong sense of ownership — you feel accountable for outcomes, not just tasks Are deeply curious — you ask why, dig into systems, and want to understand how things really work Are AI-native by instinct — you already use AI tools daily to think, write, analyze, and prototype, and you actively push the people around you to work differently Thrive in fast-moving, high-expectation environments Love building, especially in under-defined or shifting problem spaces Make decisions with incomplete information and adjust quickly Communicate clearly and align engineers, designers, and stakeholders around a direction Experience & Skills 5+ years in product management, engineering, or similar problem-solving roles — but we weight demonstrated traits and trajectory over years served A track record of shipping real products or systems that customers used and cared about Strong analytical thinking and comfort operating in complex, technical domains Sharp written communication — PRDs, specs, narratives, decision docs Preferred (not required): degree from a top-tier institution (IIT, IIM, XLRI or equivalent) Preferred (not required): experience with enterprise data environments, data integration, metadata management, or developer-facing products #LI-AS1 Alation, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Software engineering foundation — you understand how code works at a fundamental level. Formal CS/engineering education or equivalent hands-on experience required. Technical proficiency — SQL is required. Python or Java Script proficiency is required. Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON/XML parsing, and scripting for data manipulation is expected. You're comfortable reading docs, working in a terminal, and building integrations from scratch — not just dragging and dropping. Mandatory experience with GTM orchestration platforms — hands-on, demonstrated experience building workflows in at least two of: Clay, Gumloop, n8n, Make, or Zapier. Hands-on expertise with GTM tools — deep working knowledge of Salesforce and Marketo, with practical experience in at least two of: Outreach, 6sense, Zoom Info, Apollo, or similar platforms. AI-native mindset — you already use AI tools (Claude, Chat GPT, Copilot) daily in your work and are always looking for the next workflow to automate. You've built AI agent workflows, experimented with prompt chaining, and understand how to orchestrate LLMs within GTM systems. This isn't aspirational for you — it's how you operate. Builder mentality — you'd rather ship an 80% solution today and iterate than spec a perfect one for next quarter. You move with urgency and own the outcome. Analytical rigor — you understand funnel mechanics, attribution, and pipeline math. You don't just build automations — you measure whether they work.
